_comment: Input for portfolio.mjs: one real PE firm's portfolio companies, from its public site. Used for totals only (portfolio_report.json names no company). Known exits (HCSS, Infogix, Veriforce, Trader, Continuum, Mediware) are left out; a few holdings may have changed since. Domains are each company's main website.
source: https://www.thomabravo.com/portfolio (company pages and press releases on thomabravo.com)
